what: Fixture world (local-only after migration), no model: English, Continue (migrates), walk home → 1,0 → home → 0,1 in Play, then quit from Play with Browser.close

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) { const s = S.useSessionStore.getState(); const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world; if (s.screen === 'play' && w.status === 'ready') break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world; return JSON.stringify(w.status === 'ready' ? { world: w.value.worldId.slice(0, 12), head: w.value.now.head.n, link: w.value.status.link, role: w.value.status.role, writable: w.value.status.writable, me: w.value.status.me?.slice(0, 10), visits: Object.values(w.value.now.events).filter(e => e.kind === 'visit').length } : w) })()

(async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world.value; return JSON.stringify({ chunk: S.useEngineStore.getState().chunk, screen: S.useSessionStore.getState().screen, head: w.now.head.n, visits: Object.values(w.now.events).filter(e => e.kind === 'visit').length }) })()
